quote: Eye sizes and interdistances: AME 0.18, ALE 0.20, PME 0.20, PLE 0.23; AME–AME 0.14, AME–ALE 0.13, PME–PME 0.16, PME–PLE 0.27, ALE–PLE 0.08.
note: new trait key eye_diameter_mm as on main (Speleoticus hei, desk-d349; Hongkongia liutang, desk-d357), Methods define eye size as maximum dorsal diameter. Registry: WSC species page wsc.nmbe.ch/species/yadong lists Mallinella yadong Wang, Mu, Lu, Xu & Zhang, 2024, Zodariidae, accepted, original description ZooKeys 1200: 183-198. Licence: the page prints 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0),' (first line read; fetch tool truncates); Crossref: license http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, vor, start 2024-05-08, issued 2024-05-08, volume 1200, page 183-198. Anatomy only; no visual function claimed. Not on main (grep of the whole docs/ tree for the four species and 120528: no hits). The sentence came back from the fetch tool in two pieces (up to the first semicolon; the interdistances after it) and was joined at the semicolon. Sister species Asceua chayu is female-only and not filed.

eye: PME (posterior median eye), maximum dorsal diameter
method: measurement of the preserved male holotype as listed in the species Description; Methods: 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum dorsal diameter.' and 'All measurements are in millimetres.'
conditions: Male holotype SWUCT-ZOD-05-01, Yadong County, 3044 m, Xizang, China, 10 July 2018, L. Wang, Z. Wu & Y. Mu leg.; the same sentence gives AME 0.18, ALE 0.20, PLE 0.23; paratype and female values not recorded. One eye per record, as for Speleoticus hei (desk-d349, audit 464).
